checkpoints.label: T1
checkpoints.title: Agent Office
checkpoints.pitch: A dev team of Claude Code agents you run from your phone. You give the order; they plan, build, review and test it as pull requests; you tap merge.
bullets: Problem: coding agents need constant babysitting, and you can't supervise them away from your desk.
Built: an Orchestrator splits orders into tasks; specialist agents work in parallel in their own git worktrees, and a Reviewer and QA agent check every PR before it reaches you.
Result: a phone-installable PWA with push notifications that approve plans and merge PRs, plus per-agent budgets, deny rules and a kill switch.

mascot.line: Turn one. Agent Office: my dev team lives on my phone. I just tap merge.

checkpoints.label: T2
checkpoints.title: Dolphin
checkpoints.pitch: Open-source persistent memory for LLM apps and AI agents: vector search plus a knowledge graph.
bullets: Problem: LLM apps and agent sessions forget everything between conversations.

Built: a Python SDK (add, search, get_context) and an MCP server + Claude Code plugin; an LLM extracts subject-relationship-object triples into a graph, and recall walks one hop out so related facts surface even with no shared words.
Result: runs fully local (SQLite, ONNX embeddings, Ollama), published on PyPI as dolphin-memory; my most-starred repo.

mascot.line: Turn two. Dolphin gives AI a memory. Your next session already knows what the last one decided.

checkpoints.label: T3
checkpoints.title: Tokenmeter
checkpoints.pitch: A local-first Windows dashboard for Claude Code usage: tokens, costs, cache savings and activity, fully offline.
bullets: Problem: heavy Claude Code users can't see where their tokens and money go.
Built: an Electron app that reads local session files and shows cost, cache savings, a 30-day projection, a 90-day heatmap, peak hours and per-project sparklines.
Result: zero telemetry, no API keys, a system-tray counter and a pixel companion; shipped as installer and portable builds.

mascot.line: Turn three. Tokenmeter: telemetry for your AI spend. Fitting, on a race track.

checkpoints.label: T4
checkpoints.title: Janus
checkpoints.pitch: An AI revenue-recovery agent for failed payments, broken mandates and overdue B2B invoices. Razorpay Buildathon, Track 03.
bullets: Problem: revenue leaks through failed debits, revoked mandates and late invoices, each handled reactively with no record of what was tried.
Built: one agent that detects, diagnoses the root cause, picks a bounded action on an escalating channel ladder (nudge, SMS/email, voice, human) and reports ₹ at risk vs ₹ recovered.
Result: guardrails written as tested code, not prompts, that can override the LLM; a full replayable audit trail and a live recovery dashboard.

mascot.line: Turn four. Janus chases failed payments, and the guardrails can overrule the AI.

checkpoints.label: T5
checkpoints.title: Multimodal RAG · HackRx 6.0
checkpoints.pitch: Answers questions over 800+ page documents in under 18 seconds. Top 180 of 46,178 participants.
bullets: Problem: answer insurance and policy questions accurately from huge, messy documents under a strict time limit.
Built: a FastAPI retrieval pipeline with local models and Gemini 1.5 Flash, crash-proof parsing and multi-key rate-limit handling.
Result: about 90% accuracy, sub-30s responses (under 18 s on 800+ pages), Top 180 of 46,178 at Bajaj Finserv HackRx 6.0, built as a third-semester team.

mascot.line: Turn five. 800 pages, under 18 seconds. Top 180 out of 46 thousand.
